ticket.subject: Scheduled reports arrive an hour late
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

Writing on behalf of Glimmerbrook BV. Since the daylight saving change, our scheduled reports arrive an hour later than the time we set.

We can send the reports by hand in the meantime.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please let us know if we need to change anything.

Yours sincerely,
Tomasz

label_notes: clean bug (bug-timezone): impaired with a workaround is P3; urgency medium: action needed this week.
